text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, I placed. I guess my hard work did pay off, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it too ambitious of me to have wanted
first? Be
honest, what do you think
about today's result?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it too ambitious of me to have wanted
first? Be
honest, what do you think
about today's result?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Are you being serious? I'm kinda pissed I
didn't
win, not gonna lie.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you sound way too confident, but
I'm glad
you have so much trust in me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're right, the way I ran today made
me feel
like I can actually do better.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Now I'm pumped. I'll get it next
time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But I'm relieved. You think I can do
better too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I can't be satisfied with just placing. I
want
everyone to see me as a strong
runner.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's that mad enthusiasm again... But
you're
right. I'm going to keep on, no
matter how
grueling the fight.
choice_data_list: なら練習あるのみだね！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough, I'll be an even better
version of
myself!
